_doc: Machine-readable funding registry. scripts/funding_verify.py reads it on a schedule (.github/workflows/funding-maintenance.yml) and files issues for stale, expiring or broken entries. Update last_verified only after reading the primary source. status: verified = read at the primary source on last_verified; secondary = taken from a third-party summary; unverified = from memory or not reachable.

items.name: Sovereign Tech Fund
items.amount: min EUR 50,000 project cost; no max stated
items.notes: Open digital base technology only; OSI/FSF licence; no prototypes; user-facing apps not currently sought; about 6 months to contract. Fit: later, needs prevalence.

items.name: NLnet / NGI Zero Commons Fund
items.amount: not stated on page (typically EUR 5k-50k, unverified)
items.notes: Page is inconsistent: Aug 1 2026 deadline for two themed calls, 2027-01-03 per banner. Check the regular commons call and country eligibility.

items.name: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
items.notes: Rolling. Needs licence, demonstrated community traction and adoption, governance; max 2 applicants; 15 h programme. Fit: after public release and adoption.

items.name: Mozilla Foundation (Democracy x AI cohort, MOSS)
items.notes: 2026 cohort closed 2026-03-16 per third-party summary. Watch for the next call; civic framing needed.

items.name: Alfred P. Sloan Foundation (digital technology / open source)
items.amount: up to $750,000 over two years (2023 call)
items.notes: Read at sloan.org 2026-11-10: the open-source call found is the OSPO LOI for US higher-education institutions only, 2023 deadlines passed. Not applicable to a company; no other open Sloan call was found. Do not use in any pitch.

items.name: Ford / Mellon / Sloan digital infrastructure funders
items.notes: Research and ecosystem funders, mostly invitation. Not an application route today.

items.name: Open Technology Fund (FOSS Sustainability Fund and others)
items.notes: Internet-freedom scope only. Poor fit unless a censorship-resistance use case is built.

items.name: Humanity AI pooled fund open call
items.notes: Public-interest AI. Summer 2026 call; check for next round.

items.name: NSF POSE (Pathways to Enable Open-Source Ecosystems)
items.amount: Phase I up to $300,000 (1 yr); Phase II up to $1,500,000 (2 yr) under the archived NSF 24-606
items.notes: Read at nsf.gov 2026-11-10: NSF 24-606 is archived and replaced by NSF 26-506 (not read yet; read it before any outreach). Under 24-606 for-profit US-based, US-owned organizations were eligible; needs a US entity, so blocked on FUND-3 (entity). Not a current opportunity until 26-506 is read.

items.name: Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation)
items.amount: no cash stated; GitHub Enterprise and Cloudflare benefits
items.notes: Proposal via aaif/project-proposals; needs adoption, community, 6-12 month roadmap. Neutral-home option, later.

items.name: Apache Software Foundation Incubator
items.notes: Entry process page not retrieved. ASF takes ownership of code and trademarks; incompatible with keeping a commercial layer under our name unless planned.

items.name: Open Source Collective (fiscal host)
items.notes: Fiscal sponsorship for small donations and sponsors; confirm fee and eligibility.

items.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
items.amount: USD 2,000 Start; up to 350,000 Scale AI
items.notes: Detail in docs/funding/funding-options.md (docs repo). Needs live site, domain email; Scale AI needs institutional round.

items.name: Cloudflare for Startups
items.notes: Tier 3 bootstrapped. Needs live site.

items.name: AWS Activate
items.notes: See funding-options.md.

items.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
items.notes: See funding-options.md.

items.name: NSF SBIR/STTR (America's Seed Fund)
items.notes: Reauthorised through 2031-09-30 per third-party summary; nsf.gov not reachable. Requires US small business, mostly US-owned; Project Pitch first. Eligibility depends on where the entity is formed.

items.name: Y Combinator
items.notes: Fall 2026 deadline passed (2026-07-27). Next deadline not published as of verification. Public demo day: apply only after filing.

items.name: Techstars
items.notes: Each programme publishes its own dates.

items.name: EIC Accelerator (EU)
items.notes: Cut-off 2026-11-04 per third-party tracker (passed). EU entity needed. Watch the next cut-off if the entity is EU.

items.name: NVIDIA Inception
items.notes: Rolling intake.
